decisive_items: Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis (hematoxylin-eosin stain)
response.rationale: The presence of acid-fast bacilli is a definitive finding for lupus vulgaris, while the diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes is more suggestive of sarcoidosis, but the acid-fast bacilli take precedence

rejected.why: Elevated rheumatoid factor and imaging findings are not specific enough to outweigh the definitive modality finding of acid-fast bacilli
